data_scope: Embedded SharedGameConfig.mpa from the user-supplied APK
numeric_values_source: Decoded MPC payload, never the reference schema
schema_limit: Names and enum labels are correlated against the pinned reference; numeric and textual payloads are from APK bytes.

numeric_rules.ordinary_wire2: Signed zigzag integer; bool is 0 or -1
numeric_rules.F1D: EnemyAgeScalingConfig getters return F1D; F1D.Raw getter returns UInt64; recover unsigned varint and divide by metadata constant Multi=100
numeric_rules.FD6: Recover two UInt64 words from nested tagged structs, combine into the observed non-negative 128-bit value, divide by metadata Precision=1000000

AutoItemMapping.json: Keep only Age >= 0 and keys in APK ItemBalancingLibrary (231 equipment rows)
Add KoreanName by exact integer LocalizationId from APK Items_ko table (231/231 matched)
